tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the basin/leak fit, and the archive identifies a coupled memory ODE requiring at least eight rows. Acquire the fine trajectory batch to obtain the needed discriminating data before fitting another mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archive indicates this four-parameter mechanism needs at least eight informative rows; only seven are available.

considered_alternatives.option: Retry the heterogeneous saturating basin with external leakage
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 0.768 is far above the 0.045 tolerance, so this fitted mechanism is refuted.
A long-horizon observation is already present; the more specific remaining evidence gap is trajectory support for the coupled memory mechanism.
A targeted trajectory batch remains available to test a concrete candidate; the observations do not show non-stationary high-frequency sign oscillations.
